scope: Independent novelty / anti-rescue audit of the six V4 proposal packets against the cumulative forbidden-family inventory, per PLAN_forex_v4.md sections 1.1 and 8. Decision series only; NO PnL, NO scored computation, NO repairs.

declared_bar.declaration_order_guarantee: The bar file was written and frozen in the auditor worktree before the measurement script (research/audits/forex_free_v4/scripts/a7n_measure.py) was first executed; the raw measurement output (a7_n_measurements_raw.json) records the bar file reference. No threshold was moved after numbers were seen.
declared_bar.gating_statistic: Spearman rho over ACTIVE shared cells: (pair, daily 16:00 America/New_York decision-clock) cells of the shared decision grid where BOTH books hold a non-flat direction. This operationalizes the ancestry question: when both books are in the market, do they point the same way? A re-grade of the ancestor must agree in direction where both trade.
declared_bar.supporting_diagnostics_non_gating: rho_full over ALL shared cells (flats included; attenuated by flat-state participation asymmetry), active direction-agreement rate, n_shared (total and active). Where diagnostics disagree, the gating rho decides and the disagreement is reported.

thresholds.conditional: 0.5 <= |rho_gating| <= 0.7 (reported to owner with analysis; owner decides at D2)
thresholds.indeterminate: n_shared_active < 30 (verdict CONDITIONAL; NOVELTY_PASS unavailable on this measurement alone)

declared_bar.absolute_value_rationale: |rho| because a sign-inverted clone is equally a rescue under the blanket clauses.
declared_bar.front_door_rule: ADMITTED iff |rho_gating| < 0.5 vs BOTH the as-scored and the evidenced-corrected ancestor variants with n_shared_active >= 30 on both; REJECTED iff |rho_gating| > 0.7 vs EITHER variant; CONDITIONAL otherwise.
declared_bar.non_applicability_branch: Where a decision series cannot be measured (V1/V2 intraday session families; data-blocked V4 proposals), verdict by systematic feature comparison on four recorded features per forbidden row: information source, decision clock, causal control, signal functional form. NOVELTY_PASS requires all four distinct from the row; any shared load-bearing feature is CONDITIONAL or NOVELTY_FAIL as recorded.

reconstruction_method.family2_anchor_variants: The frozen V3 family2 module (research/assets/forex_free_v3/family2.py in the V3 worktree) was imported READ-ONLY and driven directly (load_h1_bars / PairSeries / _schedule_pair) with the frozen PolicyRateReader over two vintage sets: variant (a) as-scored = V3 asserted-bound vintages data_raw/forex_free_v3_macro (V3 tree); variant (b) corrected = evidenced vintages data_raw/forex_free_v3r_macro_evidenced (V3R tree). Decision clock: completed daily 16:00 America/New_York bars, Mon-Fri, 220-valid-NY-day warmup, H1 snapshot data_raw/forex_free_v1 (V3 tree), identical for both variants. A mirrored walk recording per-clock direction state was CERTIFIED by exact trip equality against the frozen _schedule_pair output on all 7 pairs in both variants (see checks). NO PnL and no financing events were computed.
reconstruction_method.a4p1_anchor: Packet-spec state machine over the pinned v2-ledger P0a evidenced vintages (data_raw/forex_free_v4_macro_evidenced, V4 tree): kappa = 48 bps, hysteresis band 0.10, warmup seed w_booked = w_target at first readable clock, forced unwind on differential sign flip or zero, entry/re-size when |dw| >= 0.10, state = sign(w_booked) after each daily 16:00-NY decision clock, macro grid 2019-01-02..2026-09-02.
reconstruction_method.a4p2_anchor: Packet-spec state machine on the snapshot session calendar: events = deduped (area, effective_date, LAST-ROW-WINS) pinned-ledger RATE_CHANGE rows of either leg gated at first_readable_decision_utc; entry at first clock at/after an update iff |Delta_r| >= 48 bps (window-open baseline counts as the initial evidenced state); H = 63 sessions; event-exit on sign flip or |Delta_r| < 24 bps; cost-stressed unwind = 5-session realized vol (sample std of 5 daily log returns of 16:00-NY closes) > 2.5x trailing 63-session median on two consecutive clocks, with lockout until the next evidenced update; trigger inert before the 68-session warmup.
reconstruction_method.a6p2_anchor: Packet-spec state machine: events = deduped RATE_CHANGE rows with delta != 0 gated at operative_available_time_utc; T = first snapshot session stamp >= a (NO_EVAL before 2020-02-11 per packet); direction per frozen area->pair map (US drives all 7, long-USD on hike); H = 10 NY-days; no refresh while positioned; tie-break earlier availability.
reconstruction_method.no_pnl_statement: Every series in this audit is a decision series (pair, decision clock, signed direction in {-1,0,+1}). No price PnL, cost, financing, fold or gate computation was performed anywhere.

integrity_checks.p0a_evidenced_vintage_hashes: All 8 areas computed canonical sha256 match BOTH the tree manifest and the worktree p0a_evidenced_vintages_manifest.json (see a7_n_measurements_raw.json checks).
integrity_checks.family2_walk_certification: Mirrored-walk trips == frozen _schedule_pair trips, exact, 7/7 pairs, both variants (raw trips per pair a/b: AUD 17, EUR 18, GBP 13, NZD 24, CAD 25, CHF 24, JPY 17 = 138 raw round trips per variant; the raw schedule book, not the runner's scored/purged subset).
integrity_checks.decision_diff_table_replication: The V3R decision_diff_table.json was replicated row-exactly from my two vintage readers: n_diff 158/158, n_sign_flips 19/19, row (pair, decision_ts) sets EQUAL. This certifies the as-scored vs evidenced reader pair that produced the two family2 variants.
integrity_checks.cross_check_interpretation: The 158 readable-rate differences / 19 sign flips land almost entirely outside family2's in-market evaluable states, so the two ancestor variants' decision panels agree at rho 0.9993 with only ~2-4 differing active cells - the ancestry correction changes the contract, not the direction series.

measurements.method_common: Decision-level Spearman rho (average-rank ties) over shared (pair, decision-clock) cells; values in {-1,0,+1}; non-evaluable cells (None) excluded. Gating rho on ACTIVE cells (both books non-flat). Window: family2 evaluable span (~2020-11..2026-09) intersected with each proposal's evaluable span; 7 pairs; 9491 total shared cells.

measurements.diagnostic_divergence_note_A4P2: A4-P2's rho_full (0.46) sits below 0.5 while its gating rho is 0.997-0.999. The divergence is a participation artifact, not direction novelty: family2 is flat in HIGH-vol states (56% of shared cells active) while A4-P2 holds through vol with only extreme crash-unwinds (24% of shared cells active, overlapping ALL of family2's active cells). Wherever BOTH books are in the market they agree on direction 99.9% of the time. Per the declared bar the gating statistic governs; both numbers are reported to the owner.

owner_report_block.heading: A7-N FRONT-DOOR DECISION + RHO TABLE (verbatim-ready)
owner_report_block.text:
A7-N declared its admission bar in writing before computing any rho (research/audits/forex_free_v4/A7_N_DECLARED_BAR.md): |rho| < 0.5 with n_shared_active >= 30 admits novelty; 0.5-0.7 CONDITIONAL; > 0.7 = re-grade of the ancestor = REJECT; gating statistic = Spearman rho over shared decision cells where BOTH books hold a position. Measurements (decision-level, decision series only, no PnL; family2 variants reconstructed from the frozen code, certified trip-exact against the frozen walk and row-exact against the V3R decision_diff_table 158/19):

(1) FXFV4-A4-P1 vs V3-family2 as-scored: n_shared 9491 total / 5335 active; rho_gating = 1.000; rho_full = 0.750.
(2) FXFV4-A4-P1 vs V3-family2 evidenced-corrected: rho_gating = 1.000; rho_full = 0.750.
(3) FXFV4-A4-P2 vs as-scored: rho_gating = 0.9974 (active agreement 99.87%); rho_full = 0.464.
(4) FXFV4-A4-P2 vs evidenced-corrected: rho_gating = 0.9991 (active agreement 99.96%); rho_full = 0.465.
(5) FXFV4-A6-P2 vs as-scored: rho_gating = 0.0537 (agreement 52.7%, chance); rho_full = 0.013.
(6) FXFV4-A6-P2 vs evidenced-corrected: rho_gating = 0.0538; rho_full = 0.013.
(7) Internal control, ancestor variant (a) vs (b): rho_gating = 0.9993 - the availability correction changes the contract, not the direction series.

FRONT-DOOR DECISION (declared bar applied to the numbers): FXFV4-A4-P1 REJECTED (rho 1.000/1.000 - direction-identical to the invalidated ancestor at every shared in-market cell; its novelty is sizing/timing machinery only). FXFV4-A4-P2 REJECTED (rho 0.997/0.999 - direction-identical where both trade; the low rho_full is a participation artifact, disclosed). The section-1.1 carry front door is CLOSED for cycle FOREX-FREE-V4. A4-P2's policy-change-drift sibling on the open axis, FXFV4-A6-P2, is MEASURED NOVEL (rho 0.054/0.054) and is not a front-door case.

Per-proposal novelty verdicts: FXFV4-A4-P1 NOVELTY_FAIL; FXFV4-A4-P2 NOVELTY_FAIL; FXFV4-A5-P1 CONDITIONAL (data-blocked, unmeasurable; feature-distinct from all intraday rows but PARTIALLY SHARED policy-rate leg with the invalidated ancestor - its own inflation-inversion placebo governs at scoring; re-measure when the CPI ledger lands); FXFV4-A5-P2 NOVELTY_PASS on features (zero rate input; data-blocked); FXFV4-A6-P1 NOVELTY_PASS on features (price-only, all four features distinct from every forbidden row); FXFV4-A6-P2 NOVELTY_PASS on measurement. Both A4 packets' confirmatory_re_entry flags must be recorded in the family verdicts and the cycle denominator as re-entries rejected at D2 on measured ancestry, not as fresh families.

limitations: Decision-series audit only: no PnL, costs, financing, folds, gates or validator runs were computed; nothing here speaks to any proposal's profitability, only to whether a V4 survivor would be new information or an ancestor re-grade.

The gating statistic conditions on both books trading. Flat-state structure differences (family2's vol-regime gate vs A4-P2's event/lockout structure) appear only in rho_full; the declared bar resolves this in favor of the gating rho and both diagnostics are reported. This choice was frozen before measurement.

A4-P1's macro grid starts 2019-01-02; clocks before the price-snapshot span (2020-01-30) cannot actually fill on the frozen snapshot. This affects only states before family2's first evaluable day (~2020-11) and cannot affect the shared-panel results.

A4-P2's crash-unwind estimator details (5-return sample std, trailing 63-session median, exit-fill session offset +-1) are not fully pinned by the packet text; at the measured rho resolution (0.997+) +-1 session convention choices cannot change the verdict.
A6-P2's H-day exit fill is pinned to entry_session + H (the packet's 'after the H-th completed NY-day' admits a +-1-session reading); immaterial at the measured rho.

The family2 variant reconstruction drives the frozen modules directly and is certified two ways (exact trip equality; exact diff-table replication), but a shared misreading of the frozen law would propagate; no such divergence was found.

My family2 walk yields 138 raw round trips per variant (schedule book incl. force-flat exits), which is NOT the runner's scored/purged trade count published in the V3/V3R ledgers (113/103); the difference is population definition, not reconstruction error, and is irrelevant to decision-level rho.
A5-lane verdicts are feature-level because the CPI evidence is not wired; they are re-measurable and the A5-P1 packet itself accepts veto on a measured rho after conditioning.

Thresholds (0.5/0.7, n >= 30) are auditor judgment frozen ex ante per the PLAN's requirement that eligibility be an audit decision on measured numbers; a different owner could re-run the committed script against the frozen inputs and obtain identical numbers.
The audit is bounded by the packets as written: any later packet amendment voids the corresponding verdict until re-audited.
